request_reviews.rationale: Verification bug, not an acceptance change: C04 (pipeline/oracle_checks.py check_C04_equity_has_shares) requires 70 pct of equity rows to have shares_held, and fund interests that print a par with '-' under Unit have no count to publish. The oracle reads holdings only, so 'dash under Unit' needs a holdings-side proxy: exclude rows whose source tags InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount and no InvestmentOwnedBalanceShares. That keeps a common-stock or unit row whose count was dropped (no principal tag) in the denominator, so a real missing count still fails. It must not be a label exclusion ('LP Interest', 'LLC Interest'): Snowbird c-300 'LP Interest' prints 393,246 under Unit, and a label rule would let a dropped count through. Required with the repair: that real-error test and the per-sandbox measurement per the contract.
